decision: Stop this paired-block gradient-selection branch and its random control; no second bank or block-size/RMS/selection variants.
reason: Candidate does not improve the strong original512 bilateral reference on average and has opposing effects across orders. Its small average gain over the same-pool random control also reverses sign between orders. Both new arms incur extra candidate data access and960 backward probes per run.
mechanism_observation: The matching objective decreases at every optimized arrival but does not yield a consistent final development gain. This limits the usefulness of the chosen single-initialization gradient objective; it is not a proof that all calibration selection is ineffective.
scope: One exposed bank, two correlated orders. Task-deletion ranges are sensitivity, not confidence intervals; no new performance threshold.
next: Audit and concretize adaptive optimization in the changing row-wise old/new expert span, including closest transport/preconditioning prior art.
